title: Filtered morphism restrictions to cycles, boundary quotients and representatives
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and U,V finite filtered integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration]. Fix p,q,r in Z with r >= 1, a filtered map t:U -> V, step restrictions s_i with their inclusion equations, and a graded map g with its quotient projection equation. Assume boundary-to-cycle containments hBZ for the subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. There exist kz:Z_r(U)->Z_r(V) and k:coker(B_r(U)->Z_r(U))->coker(B_r(V)->Z_r(V)) with the cycle inclusion and cokernel projection squares. The same g admits page-one restrictions kz₁,k₁ with those squares. There is also ρ:R_r(U)->R_r(V), restricting s_p in degree p+q to unquotiented cycle representatives, with its inclusion equation. All equations are exactly those of the Lean record. No comparison isomorphisms, homology naturality or image naturality are assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.4; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Evaluate hs at each degree. The factorization of the step inclusion followed by the underlying map through the target step inclusion proves complexStep preservation (preserves_steps). Preservation of subobjects is expressed as S <= pullback(f)(T). Pullback composition and monotonicity prove preserves_pullback for a commuting square; the image-pullback Galois connection proves preserves_image. Its right adjoint preserves meets, giving preserves_inf, while monotonicity and the supremum universal property give preserves_sup. Apply these operations to the expression defining complexCycleRepresentatives, using the chain-map square, and obtain its restriction via Subobject.factorThru.

For every integer page j, preserve the intersection of the pth step with the differential inverse image of the (p+j)th step, then its supremum with the (p+1)th step. Pull back along the pth step inclusion and push forward along the graded quotient. The evaluated hs and hg squares and preserves_pullback/preserves_image give hcycle j. For hboundary j, instead use preserves_image on the incoming differential and the (p-j+1)th step, then apply the same intersection, supremum, pullback and graded image operations. Restriction yields kz and kb with their inclusion equations. Postcompose the proposed boundary-to-cycle square with the target cycle inclusion; rewrite hz, hb and Subobject.ofLE_arrow, then cancel this monomorphism. Use cokernel.map on the resulting square, with cokernel.π_desc giving the projection equation.

Instantiate the quotient construction hquot at r with hr and at 1 with 1 <= 1. Combine their witnesses and equations with the representative restriction from hrep p (p+q) r. No extra first-page comparison or special case is used; zero steps and objects satisfy the same universal properties.
